label: Dust storm
effect: Walking speed × dust_storm_speed_factor (0.70) and terrain risk × 1.5 (env.json → dust).

label: Solar particle event
effect: Dose rate + unshielded SEP rate (env.json → radiation.solar_storm); return to shelter.

label: Suit leak
effect: O2 consumption × suit_leak_multiplier (1.5) from the event on.

label: Crew injury
effect: Walking speed × injury_speed_multiplier (0.5) from the event on.

label: Blocked path
effect: Terrain ahead becomes no-go (10 m radius) → replanning from the current position.
